NAME

packet_decoder_t

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/network/packet/decoder.h>

Data Fields


uint8_t header [sizeof(packet_header_t)]
size_t header_used
uint8_t * packet
size_t used
size_t size
size_t max_payload
Zero uses MAX_PACKET_SIZE; set before the first feed. bool failed

Detailed Description

Incremental wire framing. Feed only on the owning connection's serial lane. Callback borrows a complete header+payload until it returns. It must copy any bytes it retains. An error is terminal: reset before feeding a new connection.
